You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important were the changes made by Moltke to the Schlieffen Plan as a reason for its failure
in 1914? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were women to the contribution made by the Home Front to the British war effort?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
‘How important were Stresemann’s foreign policy achievements in creating stability in Germany
between 1924 and 1929? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the outbreak of war in 1939 in changing life in Germany? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was the Russo-Japanese War as a cause of opposition to the Tsarist system of
government up to 1914? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Red Army in the consolidation of Bolshevik rule between 1917 and 1921?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the impact of the Ku Klux Klan on the USA in the 1920s? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the Republican Party in opposing the New Deal? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were the military tactics of the Communists in their victory over the Nationalists in
the Chinese Civil War? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were changes made in agriculture to China’s development after 1976? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important were changes made to the Pass Laws after 1948 in strengthening the system of
apartheid in South Africa? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was de Klerk in ending white minority rule in South Africa? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was foreign help to Israel’s military successes in the wars against its neighbours
from 1956 to 1973? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were Hezbollah and Hamas in the increased tensions between Israelis and
Palestinians? Explain your answer. [40]
